3. Users pay less fee by picking exact-in vs exact-out.

Charge a % of amountSpecified and:
- Exact-in pays on what goes in
- Exact-out pays on what comes out, after LP fee and price impact

Same trade, different base. At high dynamic fees the gap is big.

Normalize both sides.
